newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy San Paolo cuts prime rate to 9.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy San Paolo cuts prime rate to 9.5 pct.

text.p: Italian banking group Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino said it was cutting its prime rate by half a point to 9.5 percent and its top rate 1.5 percentage point to 16 percent.
A San Paolo spokesman said the change was effective from Monday December 16.

San Paolo last cut its prime rate, the rate at which it lends to its best customers, and its top rate, the ceiling rate at which it lends to customers, on October 28 by 0.25 percent each following a 75 basis point reduction in official Italian interest rates.
